title: Your first network
intro: Banyan Tutors, a small tuition centre: four PCs and a printer on one switch, all on 10.1.1.0/24. Two of them can't print. Find out why from their terminals, then fix it.

tasks.text: From front-pc, ping the printer and see a reply
tasks.hint: Click front-pc, Open a terminal (or its desktop), then: ping printer

tasks.text: office-pc can't print: get it back on the network
tasks.hint: Its terminal says NO-CARRIER in ip a. Look at its Cable line: nothing is plugged in. Plug it into a free port in the office (O1).

tasks.text: room2-pc can't print either: fix its address
tasks.hint: ipconfig on room2-pc shows 10.1.2.13. Everyone else is 10.1.1.x. Give it 10.1.1.13/24.

tasks.text: Every PC can reach every other PC
